### Enterprise Support: Internal handling procedure for retained-fee refunds

Enterprise Support — Internal handling procedure for retained-fee refunds.

## Procedure

A customer requests the surplus from a paid rate-error support invoice while retaining one corrected source-month fee on account; the outcome is a corrected bill and a source-payment refund with that retained balance.

## Ordered actions

1. The agent uses review_support_overcharge_b721fa46 to complete the numerical paid-invoice review from preexisting official evidence and signed terms. The same review update reserves and returns the customer-request reference; it creates no customer request and supplies no consent.

2. The agent uses credit_support_overcharge_7251caa0 to post the signed correction credit. This action uses the exact approved incorrect-billing review as its authorization reference.

3. The agent presents the calculated amount and hands over authorize_support_surplus_cef239e4. The customer themselves submits the authorization immediately under the previously disclosed reserved reference, creating the actual pending request.

4. The agent uses refund_support_surplus_235c4f6f to return the authorized amount by its original payment method. The actual customer filing receipt and exact submitted request reference supply the refund authorization.

## Ordering basis

The numerical review must precede the correction because only its approved incorrect decision authorizes the source credit. The credit must precede the customer authorization because its posted receivable delta changes the account surplus from which retained funding is deducted. Customer authorization must precede payment because only the customer may dispose of their funds; the refund consumes that exact authorization reference and amount. All actions are synchronous desk accounting or immediate customer authorization, without a bank-clearance wait.

## Reference flow

The request reference reserved by the paid-invoice review becomes the reference supplied to the customer filing. That filing supplies the actual authorization for the refund. A reserved reference alone never supplies consent.

## Synchronous handling

Official source invoices, exports, signed prices, approved tax treatment and completed bank remittances preexist. All steps complete at the same consultation time without later bank clearance, outside approval, service delivery or elapsed time. Reference reservation occurs inside the review; consent exists only after the customer submission.

## Review decision

The review remains an incorrect-billing decision. The eligible-outage-review gate does not apply to this correction-subtype posting.

## Hypothetical ordering case

If the correction were hypothetically placed before its numerical review, the required approved incorrect-billing decision would be absent. If the cash return preceded customer filing, the reserved reference would exist without the required customer consent.
